title.zh: 逛节庆同行：你会怎样约好这一程？

description.en: Six fictional festival choices about a shared anchor event, flexible separate wandering and trying a small new activity. Find the companion role you choose today.
description.zh: 六次虚构节庆选择，约一个共同重点、灵活分开逛、试一项小新活动，发现今天愿意选择的同行方式。

introduction.en: Imagine a friendly illustrated festival where people may come and go freely. The question is how to share the visit when interests and energy differ, not how to navigate real crowds or plan emergency arrangements.
introduction.zh: 想象一场友好插画节庆，大家可自由来去。题目谈兴趣精力不同时怎样共享到访，不指导真实人群通行或紧急安排。

focus.en: Balancing a shared highlight, freedom to split up and a bounded new experience during one imaginary visit.
focus.zh: 一次节庆外出里，你更想保留共同重点、各自逛逛的自由，还是试一点新活动？

prompt.en: The illustrated program has more events than you can attend. You suggest…
prompt.zh: 插画节目单比能逛的更多，你提议……

label.en: Choose one event everybody actually wants to share.
label.zh: 选一项大家确实都想一起看的。

label.en: Agree on a simple reunion time and let people choose their own stops.
label.zh: 约简单再会时间，让各自选摊位。

label.en: Try one unfamiliar short activity together before deciding the rest.
label.zh: 先一起试一个陌生短活动，再定其余。

prompt.en: Two companions want different stalls. You…
prompt.zh: 两位同伴想看不同摊位，你会……

label.en: Make separate wandering an easy option rather than a problem.
label.zh: 让分开逛成为轻松选项，不当成问题。

label.en: Keep the one shared event and let the other stops vary.
label.zh: 保留一个共同节目，其他停点可不同。

label.en: Offer a short trial at each if both people genuinely want that.
label.zh: 若双方真愿意，提议各短试一会儿。

prompt.en: A small workshop has no clear appeal yet. You prefer…
prompt.zh: 一个小工作坊还看不出是否喜欢，你更愿……

label.en: A bounded trial with a comfortable way to leave.
label.zh: 有明确边界、方便离开的短试。

label.en: Keeping time for the highlight already chosen.
label.zh: 保留给已选重点节目的时间。

label.en: Letting interested people try while others wander elsewhere.
label.zh: 想试的人去试，其余人另逛。

prompt.en: Someone wants to pause while others still want activity. You…
prompt.zh: 有人想停一停，其他人仍想活动，你会……

label.en: Use the agreed reunion point so different paces can coexist.
label.zh: 按已约再会点，让不同节奏并存。

label.en: Check whether the shared highlight should be shortened or moved.
label.zh: 问共同重点是否缩短或改时。

label.en: Offer one very small activity only to whoever still wants it.
label.zh: 只向仍愿意的人提供一个很小活动。

prompt.en: The afternoon is nearly over. You choose…

label.en: One final moment around the event the group picked together.
label.zh: 围绕大家共选节目留最后一个共同瞬间。

label.en: A quick unfamiliar stop that does not extend the agreed visit.
label.zh: 不延长已约到访的一次短新停点。

label.en: Letting each person finish their own route and meet as arranged.
label.zh: 让各自走完路线，再按约碰面。

prompt.en: What makes this shared festival visit satisfying?
prompt.zh: 什么让这次共同节庆到访满足？

label.en: We could differ in interests without treating it as rejection.
label.zh: 兴趣不同也不被当作拒绝。

label.en: We discovered one new thing without overcommitting the day.
label.zh: 发现一件新东西，也没把一天过度安排。

label.en: There was one clear thing we chose to enjoy together.
label.zh: 有一件清楚、大家主动选来共享的事。

title.zh: 约好共同重点的同行者

summary.en: Your festival has one event that gives the shared visit a recognizable center. Not every stop needs to match for the day to feel connected. The portrait values a chosen common highlight rather than insisting the group stay together throughout.
summary.zh: 你喜欢在节庆里约定一个大家都想看的节目，让这次同行有一个共同重点。其他时间不必每站都一起走，也仍然可以觉得这一天是共同度过的。重点是一起选定，不是要求全程结队。

example.en: On a casual exhibition day, friends might agree to see one room together and leave the rest of the visit open to separate interests.
example.zh: 轻松看展日，朋友可约好一起看一个展厅，其余时间按各自兴趣走。

strength.en: One clear shared choice can make planning manageable and leave more room for difference elsewhere in the visit.
strength.zh: 先约好一个共同重点，安排就容易掌握一些，其他时间也能给不同兴趣留出空间。

tradeoff.en: A shared highlight can become compulsory if someone’s preference changes. Rechecking the choice keeps it an invitation rather than a debt.
tradeoff.zh: 如果有人临时改变主意，原先约好的重点也不该变成强制参加。再确认一次，才能让它仍是一份邀请，而不是欠下的任务。

experiment.en: For one shared outing, name a single thing you both want and keep the rest optional. Check again if either person’s energy changes.
experiment.zh: 下次共同外出，约定一件双方都想做的事，其他安排保持可选。如果任何一方精力有变，就再商量。

summary.en: Your imagined festival allows company and separate routes to coexist. A simple agreement about reconnecting lets different interests remain welcome. The result does not infer weak commitment or claim that every outing should be spent apart.
summary.zh: 你想象的节庆里，可以一起同行，也可以各自逛一会儿。约清楚在哪里、怎样再碰面，不同兴趣就能同时有位置。这不代表投入不够，也不意味着每次外出都应该分开。

example.en: Friends at a small fair might choose different demonstrations for a short while, then meet at the place they agreed without needing identical reports of the afternoon.
example.zh: 在小市集里，朋友们可以各看一段不同的演示，再到约定的位置碰面，不必整个下午看过完全一样的东西。

strength.en: Permission to differ can reduce the pressure to negotiate every stop and give a shared visit more than one satisfying route.
strength.zh: 允许各自有不同兴趣，能减少每一站都要协商的压力，也让这次共同外出有不止一种好玩的路线。

tradeoff.en: An arrangement can be too vague for someone who wants more connection. Naming the actual reunion shape can make flexibility easier to trust.
tradeoff.zh: 如果安排太含糊，想多一点陪伴的人也可能不安心。把什么时候、在哪里重新碰面说清楚，灵活安排才更容易被接受。

experiment.en: In a willing shared outing, discuss whether a short separate stretch would be enjoyable. Agree on a clear reconnection without making the split compulsory.
experiment.zh: 共同外出前，问问短暂各逛一会儿是否都觉得合适。约好怎样再碰面，也保留全程一起走的选择。

summary.en: Your festival visit finds a little room for something unfamiliar without turning it into a whole-day commitment. A short trial can be enough to discover whether you want more. The portrait follows these choices, not a general adventurousness score.
summary.zh: 你愿意在节庆里给没试过的活动留一小段时间，不必因此答应玩一整天。先试一下，就可以知道还想不想继续。这只是本次游戏中的选择，不是冒险程度的分数。

example.en: At an open craft event, you might try one sample fold with a willing friend before deciding whether to join the longer demonstration.
example.zh: 开放手工活动里，你可能和愿意的朋友先折一次样例，再决定是否参加长演示。

strength.en: A bounded first try can make novelty approachable and give a shared decision something concrete to build on.
strength.zh: 给初次体验留一个小范围，可以让陌生的活动更容易尝试，也让双方有实际体验后再商量。

tradeoff.en: Repeated little trials can still fill the whole visit. Keeping the agreed finish visible helps curiosity stay enjoyable for the group.
tradeoff.zh: 一次又一次的小尝试，仍然可能用掉整段游玩时间。记住约好的结束点，才能让好奇对大家都保持有趣。

experiment.en: Choose one short unfamiliar recreational activity with a clear end. Afterward, ask whether you actually want more before adding the next thing.
experiment.zh: 选一项没试过的短时休闲活动，先说好什么时候结束。试完再问自己是否真想继续，不急着加下一项。

description.en: Share an imaginary festival through one common highlight, time to split up or a small new experience. Six choices lead to three complete companion portraits.
description.zh: 用共同亮点、分头时间或一次新小体验，分享想象节庆。六次选择，阅读三种完整同行画像。

question.en: Can splitting up still be part of a shared festival visit?
question.zh: 分头逛，也能算一起过节庆吗？

answer.en: The free-route portrait leaves people room to choose different parts of a visit while agreeing how to reconnect. A shared anchor and a bounded new experience offer other ways to coordinate; staying together every minute is not the only option.
answer.zh: 自由路线给人选不同部分的空间，并约好怎样重会。共同锚点和有限新体验，是另两种协调方式；不必每分钟同行。
